title: SHIPPING AND DELIVERY
body_html:
We offer absolutely FREE delivery worldwide.

Shipping Times

Standard shipping orders ship by couriers "S.F Express" or "E-packet". usually take between 5-12 days to arrive at their destination, but can take longer from time to time.

Premium Shipping orders ship by couriers "DHL", "TNT", "Fedex", "Aramex" or "UPS" depending on country of destination. usually take between 4-8 days to arrive at their destination.

Orders normally are ready to ship in 1-3 days after payment. 

 

Customs and Import Tax

We do not add taxes or VAT to your order. In many countries, the buyer has a responsibility to pay taxes or duties on imported goods.  These rules vary by country, and in some cases imported goods in certain categories or below certain purchase thresholds will not incur taxes. As the buyer, it is your responsibility to understand the tax information for your country before placing an order on our site. If you are required to pay duties and/or import/sales taxes it will be due to the courier upon receipt of your order.  If you have any further questions you can contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com
author: francisco suels
